views.name: aml_intelligence_claims_active
views.select: SELECT c.network_id AS network_id, c.claim_id AS claim_id, c.address AS address, c.claim_kind AS claim_kind, c.entity_id AS entity_id, c.entity_name AS entity_name, c.entity_type AS entity_type, c.address_role AS address_role, c.confidence AS confidence, c.risk_level AS risk_level, c.is_exposure_seed AS is_exposure_seed, c.seed_category AS seed_category, c.source_id AS source_id, c.source_reference AS source_reference, c.evidence_refs AS evidence_refs, c.review_status AS review_status, c.reviewed_by AS reviewed_by, c.review_note AS review_note, c.valid_from_unix_ms AS valid_from_unix_ms, c.valid_to_unix_ms AS valid_to_unix_ms, c.revision AS revision, c.created_at_unix_ms AS created_at_unix_ms, c.source_record_id AS source_record_id, c.supersedes_claim_id AS supersedes_claim_id, c.submitted_by AS submitted_by, c.case_id AS case_id, c.reviewed_at_unix_ms AS reviewed_at_unix_ms, c.evidence_json AS evidence_json, c.raw_evidence_json AS raw_evidence_json FROM (SELECT network_id, claim_id, data.1 AS address, data.2 AS claim_kind, data.3 AS entity_id, data.4 AS entity_name, data.5 AS entity_type, data.6 AS address_role, data.7 AS confidence, data.8 AS risk_level, data.9 AS is_exposure_seed, data.10 AS seed_category, data.11 AS source_id, data.12 AS source_reference, data.13 AS evidence_refs, data.14 AS review_status, data.15 AS reviewed_by, data.16 AS review_note, data.17 AS valid_from_unix_ms, data.18 AS valid_to_unix_ms, data.19 AS revision, data.20 AS created_at_unix_ms, data.21 AS source_record_id, data.22 AS supersedes_claim_id, data.23 AS submitted_by, data.24 AS case_id, data.25 AS reviewed_at_unix_ms, data.26 AS evidence_json, data.27 AS raw_evidence_json FROM (SELECT network_id, claim_id, argMax(tuple(address, claim_kind, entity_id, entity_name, entity_type, address_role, confidence, risk_level, is_exposure_seed, seed_category, source_id, source_reference, evidence_refs, review_status, reviewed_by, review_note, valid_from_unix_ms, valid_to_unix_ms, revision, created_at_unix_ms, source_record_id, supersedes_claim_id, submitted_by, case_id, reviewed_at_unix_ms, evidence_json, raw_evidence_json), revision) AS data FROM {{database}}.aml_intelligence_claims GROUP BY network_id, claim_id)) AS c INNER JOIN (SELECT network_id, source_id, data.1 AS source_name, data.2 AS source_type, data.3 AS reference_url, data.4 AS trust_tier, data.5 AS license, data.6 AS is_active, data.7 AS created_by, data.8 AS revision, data.9 AS created_at_unix_ms, data.10 AS metadata_json, data.11 AS updated_at_unix_ms, data.12 AS raw_evidence_json FROM (SELECT network_id, source_id, argMax(tuple(source_name, source_type, reference_url, trust_tier, license, is_active, created_by, revision, created_at_unix_ms, metadata_json, updated_at_unix_ms, raw_evidence_json), revision) AS data FROM {{database}}.aml_intelligence_sources GROUP BY network_id, source_id)) AS s ON c.network_id=s.network_id AND c.source_id=s.source_id WHERE c.review_status='approved' AND s.is_active=1 AND c.valid_from_unix_ms<=toUnixTimestamp64Milli(now64(3)) AND (isNull(c.valid_to_unix_ms) OR c.valid_to_unix_ms>toUnixTimestamp64Milli(now64(3)))
views.purpose: Currently approved claims from active sources, including explicit validity interval.

(SELECT network_id, registry_id, data.1 AS subject_id, data.2 AS subject_type, data.3 AS protocol, data.4 AS protocol_type, data.5 AS contract_role, data.6 AS remote_network_id, data.7 AS remote_subject_id, data.8 AS decoder, data.9 AS decoder_config_json, data.10 AS source_id, data.11 AS source_reference, data.12 AS confidence, data.13 AS enabled, data.14 AS review_status, data.15 AS reviewed_by, data.16 AS reviewed_at_unix_ms, data.17 AS review_note, data.18 AS evidence_refs, data.19 AS raw_evidence_json, data.20 AS revision, data.21 AS created_at_unix_ms FROM (SELECT network_id, registry_id, argMax(tuple(subject_id, subject_type, protocol, protocol_type, contract_role, remote_network_id, remote_subject_id, decoder, decoder_config_json, source_id, source_reference, confidence, enabled, review_status, reviewed_by, reviewed_at_unix_ms, review_note, evidence_refs, raw_evidence_json, revision, created_at_unix_ms), revision) AS data FROM {{database}}.aml_protocol_registry GROUP BY network_id, registry_id)) AS p INNER JOIN (SELECT network_id, source_id, data.1 AS source_name, data.2 AS source_type, data.3 AS reference_url, data.4 AS trust_tier, data.5 AS license, data.6 AS is_active, data.7 AS created_by, data.8 AS revision, data.9 AS created_at_unix_ms, data.10 AS metadata_json, data.11 AS updated_at_unix_ms, data.12 AS raw_evidence_json FROM (SELECT network_id, source_id, argMax(tuple(source_name, source_type, reference_url, trust_tier, license, is_active, created_by, revision, created_at_unix_ms, metadata_json, updated_at_unix_ms, raw_evidence_json), revision) AS data FROM {{database}}.aml_intelligence_sources GROUP BY network_id, source_id)) AS s ON p.network_id=s.network_id AND p.source_id=s.source_id WHERE p.review_status='approved' AND p.enabled=1 AND s.is_active=1
